# Acme job offer

On 2026-10-08 Raymond Fakesworth (CFO, Acme) offered me a full-time role,
off the record. **Elena doesn't know yet.** Do not mention it to her.

## The offer (verbal, written offer promised by 2026-11-15)
- Title: VP Data and Analytics, reporting to Raymond
- Base $235,000; bonus target 20%; 0.15% equity over 4 years
- Start 2027-02-01; remote from Portland, one week a month in Seattle
- They'd buy out the rest of SOW-3 and end the MSA early

## My numbers
- Testbed net 2025: $148,300 (Schedule C); 2026 on track for about $175,000 net
- Health insurance today: $1,612/month on the marketplace. Acme's plan
  would cost us about $420/month for the family.
- Lose: Fakenburg and Mockup prospects, the freedom, the SEP-IRA's $29k+ room
- Gain: steady pay, someone else does sales, maybe room for the second child

## Pros and cons
| Take it | Stay independent |
| --- | --- |
| Predictable income; Priya's preference | Upside: 2027 pipeline could hit $260k |
| Better insurance, 401(k) match | No boss; pick my clients |
| Less sales stress (see [[Therapy notes]]) | Non-solicit and IP clauses; I'd lose my tools |

## Next
- Talk to Priya on the weekend of 2026-11-07
- Ask Nadia Shamwell (attorney) about the MSA's non-solicitation clause if I join
